portals.name: 中国军网 / 解放军报

documents.title: ATP 3-21.71 Mechanized Infantry Platoon and Squad
documents.summaryZh: 布拉德利机步排/班在多域作战中的运用；排在装甲/机步连与合成营中的框架；机动作战、攻防技术；非规定性指南。受众：合成营内指挥与士官。
documents.summaryEn: Bradley mech infantry platoon/squad in MDO; framework within armor/mech company and CAB; offense/defense techniques; non-prescriptive. Audience: leaders/NCOs in combined arms battalions.

documents.title: FM 3-21.71 Mechanized Infantry Platoon and Squad (Bradley)
documents.summaryZh: 早期 BFV 排作战与能力；三步枪班编制；排长/车长/班长技战术；数字化与非数字化排的计划—准备—执行。公共领域扫描。
documents.summaryEn: Early BFV platoon ops/capabilities; three rifle squads; PL/TC/SL TTPs; plan–prepare–execute for digital and non-digital platoons. Public-domain scan.

documents.title: ATTP 3-21.71 Mechanized Infantry Platoon and Squad (Bradley)
documents.summaryZh: 攻防、稳定行动、火力与保障；作为 FM 3-21.8 的机步配套。
documents.summaryEn: Offense/defense, stability, fires and sustainment; mech companion to FM 3-21.8.

documents.title: FM 3-21.8 The Infantry Rifle Platoon and Squad
documents.summaryZh: 步兵步枪排/班如何作战；非战斗行动；原则、技战术、符号；需配合连/营手册理解。
documents.summaryEn: How rifle platoon/squad fights; noncombat ops; principles, TTPs, symbology; use with company/battalion manuals.

documents.title: ATP 3-21.8 Infantry Rifle Platoon and Squad
documents.summaryZh: 对等威胁下步兵排班；组织角色、能力限制；技术性方法（非规定性）。
documents.summaryEn: Infantry platoon/squad vs peer threats; roles and limits; technical methods (non-prescriptive).

documents.title: ATP 3-90.1 Armor and Mechanized Infantry Company Team
documents.summaryZh: 装甲与机步连队在合成营/装甲旅中的运用；任务编组；攻防与稳定；连级关键人员职责。
documents.summaryEn: Armor/mech company team in CAB/ABCT; task org; offense/defense/stability; key company roles.

documents.title: JP 3-01 Countering Air and Missile Threats
documents.summaryZh: 联合层面反制空中与导弹威胁；进攻性/防御性反航空；主动与被动防空反导；C2、计划、预警；被动措施含探测预警、伪装隐蔽欺骗、疏散、加固等。
documents.summaryEn: Joint counter-air/missile; OCA/DCA; active/passive AMD; C2, planning, warning; passive measures (detect, CCD, dispersion, hardening).

documents.title: FM 3-01 U.S. Army Air and Missile Defense Operations
documents.summaryZh: 陆军防空反导作战；主动/被动 AMD 框架。检索 FM 3-01。
documents.summaryEn: Army AMD operations; active/passive AMD framework. Search FM 3-01 on armypubs.

documents.title: Passive Air and Missile Defense (USC SHIELD)
documents.summaryZh: 被动防空反导作为恢复力与威慑路径；政策与能力综述（研究报告，非条令）。
documents.summaryEn: Passive AMD as resilience/deterrence path; policy/capability survey (study, not doctrine).

documents.title: DIA The Soviet Motorized Rifle Company
documents.summaryZh: 苏军摩步连编制、训练、攻防与装备（偏 BMP）；供院校与情报教学。
documents.summaryEn: Soviet MRC organization, training, offense/defense, equipment (BMP-leaning); instructional/intel use.

documents.title: DTIC ADA039629 Soviet Small Unit Defensive Tactics
documents.summaryZh: 摩步连/营防御；核条件下疏开与配置；连支撑点、营防御地域。
documents.summaryEn: MRC/battalion defense; nuclear dispersion/layout; company strongpoints, battalion defensive areas.

documents.title: Sidorenko, The Offensive (Soviet Military Thought No.1)
documents.summaryZh: 进攻在核与常规条件下的特征；战斗任务与队形；火力与追击、渡河、夜攻等。
documents.summaryEn: Offense under nuclear/conventional conditions; missions and formations; fires, pursuit, river crossing, night attack.

documents.title: Savkin, The Basic Principles of Operational Art and Tactics (No.4)
documents.summaryZh: 战役法与战术基本原则；机动、集中、突然性、战斗积极性、保存战斗力、目标与计划一致、协调等。
documents.summaryEn: Principles of operational art and tactics: mobility, mass, surprise, activity, preservation of combat power, unity of aim/plan, coordination.

documents.title: Grau & Bartles The Russian Way of War
documents.summaryZh: 俄地面力量结构与战术；班→旅攻防专章；摩步在攻防中的战斗队形与火力理论。
documents.summaryEn: Russian ground force structure/tactics; squad-to-brigade chapters; MRC formations and fires theory.

documents.title: 《解放军报》合成营相关公开报道
documents.summaryZh: 合成营作为机动作战基本单元；模块化、多兵种嵌入等公开表述（非内部教范全文）。
documents.summaryEn: Open PLA Daily framing of combined-arms battalion as basic maneuver unit; modular multi-arm embedding (not internal manuals).

documents.title: 中国军网 合成营介绍类文章
documents.summaryZh: 营级编制概念、合成化沿革的公开科普级叙述。
documents.summaryEn: Open popular explanations of battalion organization and combined-arms evolution.

documents.title: 《苏联红军步兵战斗条令》第一部（班排连）中译翻印
documents.summaryZh: 班、排、连进攻/防御/警戒/侦察等基层规范（1942 苏军条令中译传统）。
documents.summaryEn: Squad/platoon/company offense/defense/security/recon norms (1942 RKKA infantry manual Chinese reprint tradition).

documents.title: 国防大学等学位论文题录（机步/合成/装甲）
documents.summaryZh: 外部研究对共军机械化与合成营的引述与分析（secondary）；入库以题录 + 可公开段落为准。
documents.summaryEn: External theses citing PLA mechanization/combined-arms battalions (secondary); index + open excerpts only.
